build_summary: Build 15 adds @stealtheye/dev-endpoint as a dev-only endpoint and tunnel foundation around @stealtheye/mcp-server. It models disabled, localhost-only, tunnel-config-required, reachable-dev-preview, and hosted-future modes while allowing only disabled, localhost-only, and placeholder-only tunnel config. It blocks production, public endpoints, credential material, production OAuth, tunnel secrets, cloud credentials, unrestricted live write tools, destructive operations, customer/private data, money movement, material external sends, and production deployment.
hand_authored_doc_policy: Build 15 preserves README.md, AGENTS.md, and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md unchanged. Generated sync writes only declared generated files and standalone Build 15 docs.
